Hi! In this video, I'll show you how Swift Grab downloads files on your Windows PC. Zip files, pictures, videos, and more.
intro
Swift Grab is a download manager. It splits each download into parts, so big files finish faster. And if your internet drops, it picks up right where it stopped.
setup
First, get Swift Grab from get swift grab dot com, and install it.
setup
Then add the free Swift Grab add-on to your browser. It works with Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox.
setup
In Swift Grab, open Settings, then Browser, and copy the pairing code. Paste it into the add-on, and they are connected.
zip
Let's download a zip file. On the website, just click the download link, like you always do.
zip
Swift Grab catches the download, and shows you the file name, its size, and the folder it goes to.
zip
Click Start. The file downloads in eight parts at the same time.
zip
Done! Swift Grab sorts every file by type, so your zip is waiting in Downloads, in the Compressed folder.
any
It works the same way for any file. Programs, P D F files, music, or disk images.
any
You can also click Add U R L, and paste a download link yourself.
any
Need to stop? Click Pause. Later, click Resume, and it continues, even after you restart your PC.
pics
Now, pictures. Move your mouse over a picture on a web page, and a small Swift Grab bar appears.
pics
Click the lightning button, and the picture is saved in full size, right away.
pics
Want every picture on the page? Open the add-on, choose Save all images, then This tab.
video
Videos work the same way. Move your mouse over the video, and click the lightning button.
video
Swift Grab saves it in the best quality, into your Video folder.
extra
Big downloads can wait for the night. Click Scheduler, pick a time, and wake up to everything done.
